title: VoxCeleb2 identity list + sample keys of FLAG_37 (4 877 speakers; 29 251 face tracks, 38 345 voice clips)

modes.train: not run by default: collect stages run only when forced (configs/modes.json collect_kind_runs_only_when_forced) and every collected dataset is read from FF_DATA/01_collected (class 'collected' is in always_saved_classes). Re-collecting: force the whole collect closure in ONE run, with a fresh FF_WORK and FF_USE_SAVED=collected (README.md of 11_collect): FF_FORCE=c37_vox2,c53_vox2b,c46_voxblink,c45_frames_vox2,c_frames_index,c63_frames,c87_frames_bridge,c63v_audio_cache. Forcing this stage alone mixes its new rows with the old frames / audio cache (sampling is not deterministic).

env_note: FLAG_LOCAL pinned to "0" so a value left in the caller's environment cannot switch the notebook into its local / smoke mode during a real run (smoke_env sets "1" under FF_SMOKE=1). FLAG_IN / FLAG_OUT would also bypass the runner's /kaggle paths if set by the caller and cannot be pinned here (a fixed value would be wrong): WP-A drops them from the inherited environment; never export them.

patches.new:
# [FF pin] HF revision parameter added for the reproduction repo (CHANGES.md): FF_HF_REVS = JSON {"<repo id>": "<commit>"};
# unset, or a repo not listed -> "main" = the original behaviour (the original run read resolve/main, unpinned).
FF_HF_REV = lambda repo: __import__("json").loads(__import__("os").environ.get("FF_HF_REVS") or "{}").get(repo, "main")
FF_HF_AT = lambda repo: "" if FF_HF_REV(repo) == "main" else "@" + FF_HF_REV(repo)   # [FF pin] HfFileSystem form of the same revision
# [FF url] ProgramComputer/voxceleb became gated (auto-approved terms) after the run: token from the environment only, never
# printed; no HF_TOKEN -> {} = the original anonymous request.
FF_HF_HDR = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + __import__("os").environ["HF_TOKEN"]} if __import__("os").environ.get("HF_TOKEN") else {}
ZIP_PATH = "datasets/ProgramComputer/voxceleb" + FF_HF_AT("ProgramComputer/voxceleb") + "/vox2/vox2_mp4_{}.zip"
ZIP_URL = "https://huggingface.co/datasets/ProgramComputer/voxceleb/resolve/" + FF_HF_REV("ProgramComputer/voxceleb") + "/vox2/vox2_mp4_{}.zip"
VOICE_URL = "https://huggingface.co/datasets/gaunernst/voxceleb2-dev-wds/resolve/" + FF_HF_REV("gaunernst/voxceleb2-dev-wds") + "/voxceleb2-dev-{:04d}.tar"
META_URL = "https://huggingface.co/datasets/ProgramComputer/voxceleb/resolve/" + FF_HF_REV("ProgramComputer/voxceleb") + "/vox2/vox2_meta.csv"

run_policy: Sampling is not deterministic (broken tar streams / failed range reads are skipped, spares fill in): a re-collection gives other rows than the arrays every later stage was trained on, so the 13.54 chain ALWAYS uses the collected data (skip_with). 11 face range reads failed in the original run (feats_manifest.json 'broken').
private_why: VoxCeleb2-derived keys and features; aligned with configs/data_map.json (vox2-keys private) and the private FF_DATA share
notes: Inert settings of the FLAG_12 cell copied into cell 1 (SPLIT_FILTER, EXT_SOURCES, ZIP_PREFIXES, ONLY_UNDER) are never read by this notebook: no organiser or dev data is touched.
Downstream: l42_vox2_lid, f41_t3enc_vox2 (via flag2027-vox2-keys), b_lab_data (packs feats_vox2/{face,voice}_meta.csv), c53 (reads the keys through lab-data), c45 / c63v (through lab-data).

No skip_with: the runner serves skip_with as a saved copy of the stage's KERNEL output, and no such copy exists (the FF_DATA/01_collected folders hold the exported datasets, which configs/data_map.json maps by their own ids). The stage is skipped by default because collect stages run only when forced.
feats_manifest.json 'broken.image' is a list of 11 failed face range reads (not a number): not compared by verify.

vox2_meta.csv (official VoxCeleb2 meta, HF ProgramComputer/voxceleb vox2/vox2_meta.csv) is downloaded into FLAG_CACHE (stage.ipy line 561), not into the output; c53 reads it into memory only. The copy under FF_DATA (configs/data_map.json raw/voxceleb2_vox2_meta, sha256 9a4f437f…, team copy Experiment/SCALE-CC-01/vox2_meta.csv) is therefore raw input with no producing stage by design; it is not proven to be byte-identical to the file read on 06/10 (c37) or 12/10 (c53), whose manifests record only the URL.

stage_ipy.recipe:
release/flag2027_e2e/build_notebook.py stage_cells(): code cells of the original notebook in order, empty ones skipped, CRLF -> LF, cells whose title (first line, or the name in a leading print("[cell]/[boot] ..."), cut to 90 chars) matches a drop_cells regex removed, then every patch applied in list order (each must match exactly `count` times), then ''.join(cell.rstrip('
') + '
# <<<FF-CELL>>>
' for cell in cells), written UTF-8 with LF. No global patch is assumed.

smoke_prerequisite.why: smoke uses the notebook's own local mode (FLAG_LOCAL=1 skips the !pip cell; VOX_SMOKE_IDS applies only with it), so the packages of the install cell must be present beforehand. No Docker needed.
